reviewItem.question: For "Removal of insecure configuration for exceptions: In prior versions, policy exceptions were allowed in all namespaces", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes the defaults so that policy exceptions are disabled and can only be created in a specified namespace (CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on policy exceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to preserve prior behavior.
